motion_and_interaction.hover_state: Translate -x-1 -y-1, increase hard shadow. Text color shift.
motion_and_interaction.click_state: Translate x-1 y-1, remove hard shadow (press down effect).
motion_and_interaction.success_feedback: Scale pop [0.8, 1.2, 1], color flash green. Coin icons fly up.
motion_and_interaction.combo_multiplier: Framer motion scale loop (scale: [1, 1.05, 1]) when active.

media_and_icons.icon_library: lucide-react (for standard UI) + iconoir-react (for playful/gamified icons)

images.description: Abstract light geometric background for the main dashboard and menus. Use with low opacity (e.g. 10-20%) or blend-mode multiply.
images.usage: Use as a fixed background covering the entire viewport for the home and menu screens to give a high-end tech feel.

images.description: Edgy, high-contrast grey background with subtle red accents for Boss levels.
images.usage: Use as the background for the Boss Level game mode to instantly change the vibe to intense and challenging.

images.description: 3D silver and gold hourglass/coin icon for the shop and gamified currency display.
images.usage: Use as an illustrative asset in the Powerup Shop header or next to the user's total coin balance.

accessibility.contrast: All text over backgrounds meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum. Heavy use of pure black (#09090B) on white (#FFFFFF) ensures optimal readability.
accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must use focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/30.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Disable screen shake and heavy scaling for users who opt out.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a gamified math app strictly avoiding childish aesthetics. Emulate a 'Neo-Brutalist Control Room' vibe.
Use solid white (#FFFFFF) for surfaces with hard 2px black (#18181B) borders and solid, unblurred shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#18181B]). Do not use soft drop shadows.
Implement 'Outfit' for all UI text and 'JetBrains Mono' specifically for the math questions, timers, and combo counters to give a precise, technical feel.
Game Modes should be visually distinct: Quick-fire uses standard white background, Boss mode uses the provided 'background_boss' image with darker/red accents.
Use Framer Motion for crucial gamification feedback: popping coins on correct answers, shaking the input on incorrect answers, and pulsing the combo multiplier.
Store progress, coins, and unlocked levels in localStorage. No backend required for v1.
Ensure all buttons and inputs have the specified hard borders and translate interactions to feel tactile and 'clicky'.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='mode-select-quickfire').
Note: The project uses .js/.jsx files, not .tsx. Ensure all components are written in standard JavaScript with React.
